summary: The team is in a high-stakes sprint to finalize the China Going-Global report for a mid-September launch while simultaneously prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs and redesigning the knowledge website.
summaryDetail: The most critical initiative is the joint CKGSB-IE report 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global,' targeting launch at Tech in Asia (Sep 15-16) or Tyson event (Sep 29-30) in Singapore. This week, Felix must confirm event alignment with Tech in Asia and Tyson, while the team begins translating the Chinese report and drafting a one-pager proposal. Simultaneously, the knowledge website redesign is in full swing, merging Joker's and Joseph's designs to increase article visibility and prominently feature indices (BCI, BSI); Joseph needs to share his HTML file and mark feedback by July 9. On the program front, Asia Star and Intelligent China are prioritized over US partnerships, with the Intelligent China webpage launching this week to drive traffic; the team must audit conversion tracking and analyze participant profiles. Urgent this week: resolve Outlook account lockouts, expedite social media agency selection (leaning toward Media Minds), and finalize the Shun Tian Shu press release approach. Upcoming: the website chatbot tweaks and testing due July 30, and Tech in Asia contract signing.
